family: Thai DOH 2015 standard drawings: PC plank girders, PC box beams and I-girders (round 2)

source.title: Kingdom of Thailand, Ministry of Transport, Department of Highways - Standard Drawings for Highway Design and Construction, 2015 Revision (2018 Edition)
source.source_status: current national standard drawing (DOH 2015 revision, 2018 edition, sheets revised 1/2017)
source.note: Scanned raster PDF; all values read visually at 400-500 dpi. PDF page = sheet number + 17 for sheets 205-223.

plank.drawing: PG-101, sheet 208/R1, PDF page 225: 0-45 deg skew PC plank girder bridge - girder dimensions and sections
geometry_notes: Interior plank: soffit 990 wide; outer faces vertical to h1; 70 mm inward to the key point at h2; faces then lean outward to a 900 mm top (45 mm inset each side).
Exterior plank: key profile on one side only (drawn left; the 0.51/0.48 split about the plank CG line sums to 0.99); the exposed face is vertical full height and is placed on the right (+x).

Only the 12 m plank has voids: three 150 mm circular holes at mid-depth 225 mm (h = 450). Interior holes at x = -250/0/+250; exterior holes 240, 540 and 810 mm from the keyed edge (chain 0.24/0.30/0.27/0.18).
Convention: 20 mm x 20 mm soffit-corner chamfers, from the sheet's 'CHAMFER 0.02 (TYP.)' note and the rounded soffit corners drawn in the sections; top corners sharp.
Circular voids are 64-gon approximations by default (circle_points).

box.drawing: BB-101, sheet 212/R1, PDF page 229: 0-45 deg skew PC box beam 15.00 m and 20.00 m span - plans and sections (sections A-A interior, C-C exterior)
closure_checks: interior bottom chain 0.07 + 2 b1 + 2 b2 + b3(0.29) + 0.07 = 0.99; exterior 0.07 + 2 b1 + 2 b2 + b3(0.36) = 0.99 (no key on the exposed side).
geometry_notes: Side key: vertical outer face to h7, 45-degree diagonal 70 mm inward and 70 mm up, then the face leans outward to the 45 mm top inset (same shape as the plank girder).

A '0.02' vertical callout at the top corner of every box section could not be placed with confidence (possibly a 20 mm lip above the top-inset point); it is ignored: top corner taken at (inset 45, h). Area effect < 0.1%.
Octagonal void: width b3 + 2 b2, height 2 h4 + h5, corner chamfers b2 (horizontal) x h4 (vertical); bottom at h3, top at h - h1; starts b1 inside the key line.
Exterior beam: key on the left only; exposed face on the right (+x) vertical full height. Box-beam sections are drawn with sharp soffit corners, so no chamfer is applied.
Section only: end diaphragm solid zones and transverse tie-strand holes are excluded.

drawings.IG15: IG-103, sheet 217/R1, PDF page 234, section D-D (midspan)
drawings.IG20: IG-205, sheet 223/R1, PDF page 240, sections C-C / D-D

geometry_notes: IG15 top chain 0.15/0.15/0.15 = 0.45 gives a 150 mm web (the earlier JSON note of a ~175 mm IG-103 web is superseded by this reading). Vertical chain 0.10 + 0.075 + 0.225 + 0.15 + 0.20 = 0.75.

IG20 chain 0.10 + 0.075 + 0.625 + 0.20 + 0.20 = 1.20 with top chain 0.1375/0.175/0.1375. The existing bridgebeams.th.ThDOHIGirderSection models the 825 mm below the haunch as a plain web; this r2 class resolves the 625 web + 200 bottom splay explicitly. It is the SAME profile: do not count both.
Convention (estimate): 20 mm x 20 mm soffit-corner chamfers; small undimensioned chamfers are drawn at both soffit corners (scaled ~20 mm) and DOH uses 'CHAMFER 0.02 (TYP.)' elsewhere.
